summary: Iter 37 — E2E validation of new features: Offers & Plans page (packages/memberships/coupons CRUD), POS package/membership tabs + benefits panel + coupon + points redeem + invoice, public booking coupon check + slot capacity enforcement, and AI chat greeting + welcome + offers reply. Backend: 6/6 spot-check pytest passed (list coupons/packages/memberships, /public/coupon-check valid+invalid, /public/availability 2026-07-04). Frontend: All 9 requested flows GREEN — nav-plans visible in sidebar, Plans page 3 tabs render, UITEST10 coupon created via UI (visible in DOM + used by Mira offers reply), 'UI Silver' membership created, POS pos-tab-package/pos-tab-membership work + duplicate tile shows 'Already in the bill!' toast, TEST_Loyalty guest search populates benefits panel (loyalty chip '225 pts (₹225)', membership chip 'TEST_Gold Member · 15% off services', package button 'TEST_5 Facial Pack: 4 left — Use session'), package redeem adds ₹0 'Classic Facial (package session)' line, coupon TESTQA20 applied toast, invoice INV-202607-0043 created successfully. Public booking: slots 18:00 and 18:30 on 2026-07-04 confirmed disabled=True (capacity working); coupon TESTQA20 shows book-coupon-valid green msg '20% off your bill', WRONGCODE shows book-coupon-invalid. AI widget: greeting 'May I know your name, please?' shown, sending 'My name is Kiran' returned 'Welcome to Mira chat bot, Kiran! 💖 Thank you for choosing Miracurl Unisex Family Salon.' within 3s, asking 'any offers?' returned response listing TESTQA20 (20% off), UITEST10 (10% off), TEST_5 Facial Pack and TEST_Gold Member packages. ai-voice-btn visible next to input.
action_items: OPTIONAL: server.py is now 4787 lines — still exceeds 700-line guideline; should be split into routers (coupons/packages/memberships/public-booking/ai-voice).
critical_code_review_comments: Plans.jsx uses shared plan-price-input / plan-name-input testids across package + membership modals (differentiated only by kind) — clean and works, verified UITEST10 coupon and 'UI Silver' membership save+render.

POS.jsx pos-benefits-panel correctly loads loyalty/membership/package via /customers/{cid}/benefits after guest selection. Duplicate package tile click surfaces 'Already in the bill!' toast (no qty bump) as required.

BookPublic.steps.jsx slot buttons for 18:00 & 18:30 rendered with disabled=True on 2026-07-04 — confirms _ensure_slot_capacity + /public/availability integration is wired to UI correctly. Non-capacity slots (e.g. 11:00) remain clickable.

BookingChatWidget.jsx: greeting message correct (initial state), Mira LLM reply is fast (<3s), and offers response naturally mentions the newly-created UITEST10 coupon — /public/ai-chat returns tenant-aware promo context.
Emergent LLM greeting-with-name detection works reliably on sentences like 'My name is Kiran' — no false triggers observed.
MINOR (carried from iter36): server.py monolith continues to grow.

NOTE: package session line is created at ₹0 as expected, so if only a package session is in the bill the coupon/points discounts render as ₹0 (correct behavior); pos-coupon-discount and pos-points-discount elements only mount when the discount is >0. Consider always mounting the elements (with ₹0) for clearer test-observability, but this is only a testing UX nit.
